content: GloVe pretrained word embeddings BIBREF49 are used and remain fixed during training. The dimension of encoder states ( INLINEFORM0 ) is set to 300 and a 1024D MLP with one or two hidden layers is used. We apply dropout BIBREF50 to the word embeddings and the MLP layers. The features used as input to the MLP classifier are extracted following Eq. EQREF28 .
